Enrollment Windows and Restrictions for ICS

Winter 2027: Undergraduate Enrollment Restrictions

Please check this page periodically, as course restriction dates are subject to change.

The University Registrar opens enrollment windows for UC Irvine students, which are set according to seniority levels.

ICS places additional restrictions on windows for specific courses to prioritize students based primarily on their major, and sometimes also on seniority:

ICS enrollment restrictions Google spreadsheet.

***

ICS Undergraduate Students seeking to take an ICS graduate-level course and receive permission from the instructor may email ucounsel@uci.edu for assistance beginning December 15, 2026.

NOTE: The deadline for Undergraduate enrollment in Graduate courses is 5PM PDT on December 23, 2026.  There will be no exceptions or appeals for this process, as students are not eligible for enrollment following the first day of class. 

  • 10/30/26: W27 information published
  • 11/4/26: CS 145 restriction timeline updated
  • The online listing will be updated by October 30th, 2026. Until then, refer to the General Catalogue for the most accurate and up-to-date prerequisite information.
  • UCI Prerequisites
  • Important: If you have satisfied any part of a course’s prerequisite(s) at another institution and you have not yet been cleared to enroll in that course, be sure to submit an Online Course Prerequisite Clearing request.

The School of ICS majors will have priority for seating in most School of ICS courses until 12:00pm, December 18th, 2026. See the detailed timeline for specific information.

  • If a course is a core requirement for an ICS degree, first consideration is given to students in that major.
  • If a course is a Specialization or Track requirement for an ICS degree, second consideration is given to students pursuing that Specialization or Track.
  • If a course is a core requirement for a degree outside of ICS, a third consideration will be given to students in that major following the schedule outlined on this page.
  • Majors outside the School of ICS may begin enrolling in ICS courses on December 18th, 2026, at 12:00pm.
  • Quantitative Economics Juniors and Seniors will be able to enroll in STATS 120B from 11/30/26 until 12/3/26.
  • Computer Engineering majors will be able to enroll in ICS 6D starting 12/4/26, at 12:00pm.
  • CSE majors under the School of Engineering: if you meet the prerequisites but are unable to register in an upper-division CS course (100-189), contact ICS Student Affairs for assistance. (Note: INF courses (101-171) will be available to CSE majors beginning 12/4/26).
  • Any non-ICS student found to be enrolled in ICS courses without permission from ICS Student Affairs before noon on 12/18/26 will be dropped.
  • CS 131
  • CS 132 / EECS 148
  • CS 142A
  • CS 180A
  • GDIM 167B
  • ICS 6B
  • ICS 31
  • ICS 32
  • ICS 33
  • ICS 51
  • ICS 53
  • ICS 139W (section A)
  • INF 191A
  • INF 191B
  • STATS 170A
  • Repeat restriction is in place for all School of ICS courses.
  • If you plan to repeat a course, you can start enrolling in that course at 12:00pm on 12/4/26 .

  • Any non-ICS student found to be enrolled in ICS courses without permission from ICS Student Affairs before noon will be dropped.

On December 18th, 2026, at 12:00pm:

All school/major restrictions are lifted from courses except:

  • CS 180A (will remain restricted to CS majors only)
  • GDIM 167B (will remain restricted to GDIM Seniors only)
  • ICS 139W (will remain restricted to the School of ICS)
  • INF 191A (will remain restricted to INF and SE Seniors only)
  • INF 191B (will remain restricted to INF and SE Seniors only)

School of ICS reserves the right to extend or reinstate major restrictions on courses beyond this date.
